column1: # NUR067 — await's winner-takes-all modes (first / any) hand back the
# winning branch's WHOLE residual: 0-or-more values, a count that can
# EXCEED any static seat. A single branch makes the nondeterministic
# modes deterministic, so these rows are green semantics; their compile
# status is the frontier — the 1-seat layout was a live miscompile
# (values stranded around a collecting paren), so the compile pass now
# refuses them to the interpreter. Graduation = a runtime-variadic
# region representation (an OpStackMark-style collect with no static
# count), at which point awaitVariadicResult records the region instead
# of refusing and these rows move to lang/spec/module-time.tsv.
